main_idea: PivotRL raised Qwen3.5-9B pass@5 on τ³-Banking from 11.3% to 17.5%.
ideas: PivotRL improved task success from 11.3% to 17.5%.
The method used 50 solved trajectories and profiled 193 pivot states.
Fewer examples can produce more capable agents.
summary: The chart clearly shows the pass@5 gain, while the long subtitle, decorative motif, dataset cards, and tagline add clutter.
